answer.reason: The verses give Jerusalem several events of its own: its capture, the temple built there, its rescue from Sennacherib, and its burning.

clauses.english: was taken by Judah and set on fire
clauses.quote: had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it

clauses.english: was where Solomon built the house of the LORD
clauses.quote: Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem

clauses.english: was saved from Sennacherib king of Assyria
clauses.quote: the LORD saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib

clauses.english: was burned and had its walls broken down by the army of Babylon
clauses.quote: and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great man's house burnt he with fire

doubts: GEN 14:18 names Salem, not Jerusalem, so it was left out.
The verses do not clearly say David captured the city, so it was left out.
Jesus' crucifixion near the city (JHN 19:20) was omitted as only a location.
